title: A biowaste material-based low-cost environment-friendly triboelectric nanogenerator for self-powered sensing application
content:
Sustainable Energy Fuels, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5SE00607D, Paper
Sayed Muksedul Haque Pias, Md. Nurnabi, Rahat Hossain, Md. Monjarul Alam, Kamaruzzaman, S M Sohel Rana
Water hyacinth root (WHR), a natural waste material, is effectively utilized to develop a green biodegradable TENG for healthcare monitoring, tactile sensing, and energy harvesting, alongside self-powered sensor applications.
